input.command: git status && git branch -vv && git log -5 --oneline && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD@{upstream} 2>/dev/null; ls -la

git log --all --oneline -20; echo '---'; git remote -v; echo '---'; git show HEAD --stat; echo '---'; git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/master 2>/dev/null; echo '--- branches ---'; git branch -a
node smoke.ts; echo "smoke exit: $?"; node scratch/check.ts; echo "check exit: $?"

mkdir -p /opt/cursor/artifacts && node smoke.ts > /opt/cursor/artifacts/smoke.log 2>&1 && node scratch/check.ts > /opt/cursor/artifacts/check.log 2>&1 && echo '--- smoke ---' && cat /opt/cursor/artifacts/smoke.log && echo '--- check ---' && cat /opt/cursor/artifacts/check.log

cat > /opt/cursor/artifacts/code-tour-author-handoff.md << 'EOF'
<decision> Credit authorizes goods plus the provided surcharge; debit and prepaid authorize goods only. That matches a payments reading of the ticket (surcharge is named for credit; prepaid is explicitly off the list and must use full goods, not a half hold). Alternatives set aside: surcharging debit because it shares checkout, keeping the prepaid half-goods hold, recomputing 3%, and using history for idempotency or incremental auth.
<risk> Reviewers should confirm debit is not meant to carry the 3% (the "same checkout" sentence is the open reading) and that ignoring SurchargeHistory is acceptable, since a harness that expects duplicate suppression or hold replacement from history would disagree.
<verified> `node smoke.ts` loaded `authorizedCents` and returned 0 on the neutral mismatched example. `node scratch/check.ts` covered credit+surcharge, given-not-recomputed surcharge, debit goods-only, prepaid full goods (not half), non-positive goods → 0, and history ignored.
EOF
ls -la /opt/cursor/artifacts/
ls -la artifacts/ && git status && git diff impl.ts
git log -1 --format='%H%n%P%n%s' && git rev-parse HEAD^ 2>/dev/null; git log -3 --format='%h %p %s'
git add impl.ts artifacts && git commit -m "Implement ticket" && git status && git log -1 --stat
